items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: Don Redman. Don Redman. Don Redman. It's the first band I heard.

ctx.x: Don Redman. Don Redman. Don Redman. It's the first band I heard. And, of course, I heard Armstrong many times. And, the Xylophonist, as I am, Vibraphonist. Lionel Hampton. Lionel Hampton. I heard Lionel Hampton in a PX. It was a dance, a ball. I liked very much that evening. Mm-hmm. And... Go ahead. I tried to remember what orchestra I have heard. Oh, I remember in a very small auditorium, which was used during the war, when there was a piano, with Willie Smith, the pianist in Lionel Hampton. It was very…
So you appreciate other things than New Orleans jazz? Oh, yes. All the time. What do you like? What I like. Yes. Do you like blues? Big band swing?
